description: Read one heartbeat in full, including how long its last run took. It has name, state, period_seconds, grace_seconds, ping_url, last_ping_at, last_success_at, last_start_at, last_duration_ms (how long the last run took, from its /start to its success ping), overdue_at (when it will be reported late), notification_cooldown_seconds, is_active, channel_ids and tags. Use it to answer whether a job ran, how long it took and when it is next due. To find a heartbeat use list_heartbeats; to change it use update_heartbeat; probed monitors are get_monitor.

heartbeat_id.description: The heartbeat's uuid from list_heartbeats. An id that is not a heartbeat of this organization, or a deleted one, is a 404.

name: get_heartbeat

state.description: Known values: PENDING, UP, DOWN, PAUSED.
